title: Quaint Brazilian Walnut Paella
description: A funky and pillowy one-pot Brazilian dish featuring walnuts and lamination-puff, made halal-friendly. This dish combines the flavors of Brazil with the traditional Spanish paella.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the laminated puff pastry and place it in a large skillet.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and add the chopped onion and minced garlic.
Cook the onion and garlic until they are softened and fragrant.
Add the chopped walnuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, cumin, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
